subject: Hospitality
title: The Savoy: London's First Luxury Hotel
description: A fast breakdown of The Savoy: London's First Luxury Hotel for builders.

hook.text: The Savoy opened in 1889 as London's first luxury hotel—and the first in England with electric lights, hot water, and lifts.

buildup.text: Impresario Richard D'Oyly Carte built it with profits from Gilbert and Sullivan operas. Theater funded luxury hospitality.

discovery.text: The Savoy hired César Ritz as manager and Auguste Escoffier as chef. It became the birthplace of modern hotel luxury.

twist.text: The Savoy entrance has right-hand traffic—the only road in Britain where you drive on the right.

climax.text: Over a century later, the Savoy remains London's most famous hotel. Its design, location, and history are irreplaceable.

punchline.text: Opera money, electric lights, Ritz and Escoffier. The Savoy invented British luxury.

quiz.question: What is unique about the Savoy's entrance road?
options: It's the only road in Britain where you drive on the right
